title: LLM Eval Gates in CI, Not Slide Decks
excerpt: Demo-quality prompts do not survive production traffic. If evals live only in notebooks, every model swap becomes a product lottery.
description: Staff patterns for LLM evaluation in CI: golden datasets, regression thresholds, cost-aware sampling, and release gates that product teams can trust.
socialThreadTr: Notebook evals güven vermez; CI kapısı şart. 🧵

sections.heading: Evals are release infrastructure
paragraphs: Teams that only eyeball outputs before launch discover failures in support tickets. Eval harnesses turn subjective 'looks fine' into comparable scores across prompts, tools, and locales.
Version datasets like code. When someone edits a golden case without review, you lose the ability to detect model regressions versus intentional behavior changes.
Eval datasets are code: review them in PRs with the same rigor as migration scripts.

sections.heading: Golden sets need ownership
paragraphs: Start with a small, high-signal golden set tied to revenue or compliance paths—not hundreds of vague prompts copied from marketing.
Each case should assert tool shape, citation presence, refusal behavior, or numeric bounds—not poetic similarity alone.
Gate on regressions against a frozen golden set, not on absolute scores that drift with model upgrades.
points: Treat eval suites like unit tests with fixtures and versioned datasets
Block releases on regression thresholds, not single lucky runs
Separate offline eval from online shadow traffic
Publish eval dashboards next to error budgets

sections.heading: Sample online, gate offline
paragraphs: CI should run fast eval subsets on every PR and fuller suites nightly. Expensive judge models belong in scheduled jobs, not every push.
Shadow traffic in production complements offline eval; it should not replace gates because incidents are already user-visible.
Human spot checks calibrate automated graders weekly, not only after incidents.

sections.heading: Make regressions visible
paragraphs: Publish eval trends beside latency and cost. When a model upgrade wins on quality score but doubles token spend, product should see that trade in one dashboard.
Eval gates earn the right to change models without heroics on launch night.
Failed eval gates should block deploy; waivers need named owners and expiry dates.

sections.heading: Treat eval datasets as versioned code
paragraphs: Slide-deck evals rot the week presenters change teams. Store golden prompts, expected constraints, and grader configuration beside application code with pull-request review. When product changes tone or refusal policy, update datasets in the same merge that ships the behavior, not in a quarterly spreadsheet. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

Partition sets by risk: smoke cases that run on every commit, broader regression suites nightly, and exploratory buckets that never gate production. CI time is finite; prioritization should reflect customer impact, not whichever demo impressed leadership last. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

Record dataset hashes in deployment artifacts so incident responders know which eval version approved a release. Without that linkage, postmortems debate subjective memory instead of reproducible commands developers can re-run locally. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

sections.heading: Gate on regressions, not vanity scores
paragraphs: Absolute accuracy numbers drift when vendors upgrade base models. CI should compare against a frozen baseline and fail on statistically meaningful regressions on critical intents, safety refusals, and tool-call formats. Document tolerance bands product and legal sign explicitly. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

Automated graders need calibration hooks. pytest-style tests can assert schema validity and forbidden phrases while human rubrics feed weekly spot checks that adjust weights. OpenAI eval guidance and MLflow tracking help teams share runs without exporting raw user transcripts. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

Waivers for failed gates require named owners, expiry dates, and linked tickets. Permanent exceptions become undeclared policy changes. Make waiver count a visible metric the same way you track flaky tests or security findings. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

sections.heading: Eval gates that block merges, not meetings
paragraphs: Slide-deck evals rot the week models change. Treat golden datasets as versioned code: store prompts, expected rubric scores, and judge configuration beside application logic, reviewed in pull requests like migrations. CI should replay a frozen subset on every merge request touching prompts, tools, or routing. Absolute score thresholds drift with base model upgrades; gate on regressions against the last green baseline instead of vanity ninety-five percent headlines.

Automated graders need calibration humans trust. Schedule weekly spot checks where engineers label a sample of failures; feed disagreements back into rubric wording and judge prompts. Separate flaky eval cases into quarantine with owners, mirroring how you handle flaky end-to-end tests. Failed gates block deploy; waivers require named executives, expiry dates, and linked tickets documenting customer impact accepted.

Eval harnesses must mirror production constraints—same tool schemas, latency budgets, and retrieval indices—not an optimistic sandbox with god-mode API keys. Record token spend per eval run so finance notices CI creep. Cache embeddings for static corpora, but invalidate when document stores change. Publish eval duration trends beside unit test times; slow eval trains encourage skipping locally, which defeats the purpose of gates.

Connect eval failures to observability. When a gate catches toxic output or broken JSON, add the case to synthetic probes and on-call playbooks if similar patterns could reach users. Post-incident reviews should append regressions to golden sets, not only Confluence pages nobody reads. The goal is eval gates in CI becoming the authoritative release contract, replacing quarterly deck reviews executives already ignore.

paragraphs: Slayt eval'leri model değiştiği hafta çürür. Shadow in prod completa eval offline, non sostituisce i gate.

sections.heading: Rendi visibili le regressioni
paragraphs: Pubblica trend eval accanto a latenza e costo. Upgrade qualità che raddoppia token deve essere visibile.
I gate eval permettono cambio modello senza eroi alla launch.

sections.heading: Trattare i dataset eval come codice versionato
paragraphs: Eval su slide marciscono quando i presenter cambiano team. Conservate golden prompt, vincoli attesi e config grader accanto al codice applicativo con review PR. Quando prodotto cambia tono o policy di rifiuto, aggiornate dataset nello stesso merge del comportamento, non in foglio trimestrale. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

Partizionate per rischio: smoke a ogni commit, regression più ampie nightly, bucket esplorativi senza gate prod. Il tempo CI è finito; la priorità riflette impatto cliente, non la demo che ha impressionato il leadership. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

Registrate hash dataset negli artefatti di deploy così chi risponde agli incidenti sa quale versione eval approvò una release. Senza quel legame, i postmortem discutono memoria soggettiva invece di comandi riproducibili in locale. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

sections.heading: Gate su regressioni, non punteggi vanity
paragraphs: Punteggi assoluti driftano quando i vendor upgrade modelli base. La CI confronta baseline congelata e fallisce su regressioni statisticamente significative su intent critici, rifiuti safety e formati tool-call. Documentate bande di tolleranza firmate da prodotto e legale. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

Grader automatici servono hook di calibrazione. Test pytest assertano schema e frasi vietate; rubriche umane alimentano spot check settimanali che regolano pesi. Guida eval OpenAI e tracking MLflow condividono run senza esportare transcript utente grezzi. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

Waiver per gate falliti richiedono owner nominato, scadenza e ticket collegati. Eccezioni permanenti diventano cambi policy non dichiarati. Rendete il conteggio waiver metrica visibile come test flaky o finding sicurezza. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

sections.heading: Gate eval che bloccano i merge
paragraphs: Eval su slide marciscono quando cambia il modello. Dataset golden come codice versionato: prompt, punteggi rubric, config judge accanto alla logica app, review in PR come migrazioni. CI replay subset congelato su ogni MR che tocca prompt, tool, routing. Soglie assolute derivano con upgrade base model; gate su regressione vs ultima baseline verde, non titoli vanity 95%.

Grader automatici servono calibrazione umana fidata. Spot check settimanali: engineer etichettano campione failure; disaccordi alimentano rubric e prompt judge. Casi eval flaky in quarantena con owner come E2E. Gate falliti bloccano deploy; waiver con executive nominati, scadenza, ticket impatto cliente accettato. Registrate owner, data di review e trigger di rollback nello stesso ticket di change così il prossimo on-call engineer rintraccia le decisioni senza riaprire l'incident.

Harness eval rispecchia vincoli prod—schema tool, budget latenza, indici retrieval—non sandbox ottimista con chiavi god-mode. Spesa token per run eval visibile a finance. Cache embedding corpora statici, invalida se doc store cambia. Pubblicare trend durata eval accanto unit test; eval lenti incoraggiano skip locale. Registrate owner, data di review e trigger di rollback nello stesso ticket di change così il prossimo on-call engineer rintraccia le decisioni senza riaprire l'incident.

Collegare failure eval a observability. Gate cattura output tossico o JSON rotto → aggiungere probe synthetic e playbook on-call se pattern può raggiungere utenti. Post-incident appende regressioni ai golden set, non solo Confluence. Obiettivo: gate CI come contratto release autorevole al posto delle review deck trimestrali. Registrate owner, data di review e trigger di rollback nello stesso ticket di change così il prossimo on-call engineer rintraccia le decisioni senza riaprire l'incident.

zh.title: CI 中的 LLM 评测门，而非幻灯片
zh.excerpt: 演示级 prompt 扛不住生产流量。评测若只活在 notebook，每次换模型都是产品抽奖。
zh.description: CI 中 LLM 评测的 staff 模式：黄金集、回归阈值、成本敏感抽样与可信赖发布门。

sections.heading: 评测是发布基础设施
paragraphs: 只肉眼验收的团队在工单里发现失败。评测 harness 把“看起来还行”变成可比分。
数据集像代码一样版本化；未审 golden 编辑会混淆模型回归与行为变更。

sections.heading: 黄金集需要负责人
paragraphs: 从小而高信号 golden 集起步，绑 revenue 或合规路径。
每例应断言工具形态、引用、拒绝或数值界，而非仅相似度。
points: 像单元测试一样用 fixture 与版本化数据集运行 eval
按回归阈值阻断发布，而非单次侥幸通过
分离离线 eval 与在线 shadow 流量
在错误预算旁发布 eval 看板

sections.heading: 在线抽样、离线门禁
paragraphs: CI 每 PR 跑快评子集，夜间全量；贵 judge 放定时任务。
生产 shadow 补充离线评测，不能替代门禁。

sections.heading: 让回归可见
paragraphs: 评测趋势与延迟、成本同屏。质量升而 token 翻倍须在一张盘里可见。
评测门让你无需 launch 夜英雄式换模型。

sections.heading: 把 eval 数据集当作版本化代码
paragraphs: 演示型 eval 在演讲者换团队的那周就会腐烂。将 golden prompt、期望约束与 grader 配置与应用代码同仓并走 PR 评审。产品调整语气或拒绝策略时，应在 ship 行为的同一 merge 更新数据集，而非季度 spreadsheet。
按风险分区：每次 commit 的 smoke、夜间更广回归套件、永不 gate 生产的探索桶。CI 时间有限；优先级应反映客户影响，而非上次打动管理层的 demo。
在部署产物中记录 dataset 哈希，使 incident 响应者知道哪版 eval 批准了发布。缺少该链接，postmortem 会争论主观记忆，而非开发者可在本地重跑的命令。

sections.heading: 对回归设 gate，而非虚荣分数
paragraphs: 厂商升级基座模型时绝对准确率会漂移。CI 应相对冻结基线比较，并在关键意图、安全拒绝与 tool-call 格式上出现统计显著回归时失败。容忍带需产品与法务明确签署。
自动 grader 需要校准挂钩。pytest 式测试可断言 schema 与禁用短语；人工 rubric 通过每周 spot check 调整权重。OpenAI eval 指南与 MLflow tracking 可在不导出原始用户 transcript 的情况下共享运行。
失败 gate 的豁免需具名 owner、到期日与关联 ticket。永久例外等于未声明的策略变更。将 waiver 数量做成与 flaky 测试或安全发现同级的可见指标。

sections.heading: 阻断合并而非会议的 eval 门禁
paragraphs: 幻灯片 eval 在模型更换当周就会腐烂。将黄金数据集视为版本化代码：prompt、期望 rubric 分数与 judge 配置与应用逻辑同仓，在 PR 中像迁移一样评审。凡改动 prompt、工具或路由的 MR，CI 应重放冻结子集。绝对分数阈值随基座升级漂移；应对相对上次绿基线的回归设门禁，而非 vanity 95% 标题。 在同一变更工单中记录负责人、评审日期与回滚触发条件，以便下一轮值班工程师无需重开事件即可追溯决策。

自动评分器需要人可信的校准。每周抽检：工程师标注失败样本；分歧反馈到 rubric 与 judge prompt。不稳定 eval 用例像 flaky E2E 一样隔离并指定 owner。门禁失败应阻断发布；豁免须具名高管、过期日与记录已接受客户影响的工单。 在同一变更工单中记录负责人、评审日期与回滚触发条件，以便下一轮值班工程师无需重开事件即可追溯决策。 在同一变更工单中记录负责人、评审日期与回滚触发条件，以便下一轮值班工程师无需重开事件即可追溯决策。

Eval  harness 须镜像生产约束——相同 tool schema、延迟预算与检索索引——而非带 god-mode 密钥的乐观沙箱。记录每次 eval 的 token 花费供财务发现 CI 膨胀。静态语料 embedding 可缓存，文档库变更须失效。与单元测试并列发布 eval 耗时趋势；过慢会鼓励本地跳过。 在同一变更工单中记录负责人、评审日期与回滚触发条件，以便下一轮值班工程师无需重开事件即可追溯决策。

将 eval 失败连到可观测性。门禁捕获有毒输出或坏 JSON 时，若类似模式可能触达用户，应加入合成探针与 on-call 剧本。事后回顾应向黄金集追加回归，而非只改 Confluence。目标让 CI eval 门禁成为权威发布契约，取代管理层已忽视的季度 deck。 在同一变更工单中记录负责人、评审日期与回滚触发条件，以便下一轮值班工程师无需重开事件即可追溯决策。 在同一变更工单中记录负责人、评审日期与回滚触发条件，以便下一轮值班工程师无需重开事件即可追溯决策。

ja.title: スライドではなくCIのLLM評価ゲート
ja.excerpt: デモ品質プロンプトは本番トラフィックで崩れる。評価がノートブックだけならモデル差し替えは宝くじになる。
ja.description: CIでのLLM評価：ゴールデンセット、回帰閾値、コスト意識サンプリング、信頼できるリリースゲート。

sections.heading: Evalはリリース基盤
paragraphs: 目視だけのチームはサポートチケットで失敗に気づく。Harnessは「良さそう」を比較可能スコアに。
データセットをコード同様バージョン管理；未レビューgolden編集は回帰検知を壊す。

sections.heading: ゴールデンセットにオーナー
paragraphs: 小さく高信号のゴールデンから。収益・コンプライアンス経路に紐づける。
各ケースはツール形状・引用・拒否・数値境界をassert；類似度だけでは不足。
points: evalスイートをfixtureと版付きデータセットでユニットテスト化
一発当たりではなく回帰閾値でリリースブロック
オフラインevalとオンラインshadowを分離
エラーバジェット横にevalダッシュボード公開

sections.heading: オンラインでサンプル、オフラインでゲート
paragraphs: CIはPRごとに高速サブセット、夜間フル。高コストジャッジはスケジュールジョブ。
本番シャドウはオフラインevalを補完しゲートの代わりにならない。

sections.heading: 回帰を可視化
paragraphs: evalトレンドをレイテンシ・コスト横に公開。品質向上でトークン2倍なら一枚の盤で見えるべき。
Evalゲートはローンチ夜のヒーローなしでモデル変更を可能にする。

sections.heading: eval データセットをバージョン管理コードとして扱う
paragraphs: スライド eval は発表者がチームを変えた週に腐る。golden prompt、期待制約、grader 設定をアプリコード横に PR レビュー付きで置く。プロダクトがトーンや拒否方針を変えるときは四半期表ではなく挙動を ship する merge でデータセットを更新する。
リスクで分割する。各 commit の smoke、夜間の広い回帰、本番 gate しない探索バケット。CI 時間は有限。優先度は最後にリーダーシップを感動させた demo ではなく顧客 impact を反映すべきだ。
デプロイ成果物に dataset ハッシュを記録し、インシデント対応者がどの eval 版がリリースを承認したか分かるようにする。リンクがなければ postmortem は再現可能なローカルコマンドではなく主観記憶を議論する。

sections.heading: 虚栄スコアではなく回帰で gate する
paragraphs: ベンダーが基盤モデルを上げると絶対精度は drift する。CI は凍結 baseline と比較し、重要 intent、安全拒否、tool-call 形式で統計的に意味ある回帰で fail すべきだ。許容帯はプロダクトと法務が明示署名する。
自動 grader には校正フックが要る。pytest 的テストは schema と禁止フレーズを assert し、人間 rubric は週次 spot check で重みを調整する。OpenAI eval ガイドと MLflow tracking は生ユーザー transcript を export せず run を共有できる。
失敗 gate の waiver には指名 owner、失効日、リンク ticket が要る。恒久例外は未宣言 policy 変更になる。waiver 数を flaky テストやセキュリティ finding と同様の可視メトリクスにする。

sections.heading: 会議ではなく merge を止める eval ゲート
paragraphs: スライド eval はモデル変更週に腐ります。golden dataset を version コード扱い：prompt、期待 rubric スコア、judge 設定をアプリロジック横に置き、migration 同様 PR review。prompt・tool・routing に触れる MR ごとに CI が frozen subset を replay。絶対閾値は base model upgrade で drift；vanity 95% 見出しより最後の緑 baseline への regression で gate。

自動 grader は人が信じる較正が要る。週次 spot check で engineer が failure サンプルにラベル；不一致は rubric と judge prompt へ。flaky eval case は flaky E2E と同様 owner 付き quarantine。失敗 gate は deploy block；waiver は named executive、失効、受容した customer impact チケット。

eval harness は prod 制約—tool schema、latency バジェット、retrieval index—を鏡写し、god-mode key の楽観 sandbox 不可。eval run あたり token  spend を finance 向けに記録。静的 corpus embedding は cache、doc store 変更で invalidate。eval 時間 trend を unit test 横に公開；遅い eval は local skip を促進。

eval failure を observability に接続。gate が toxic output や broken JSON を捕らえたら user に届きうる pattern なら synthetic probe と on-call playbook へ。post-incident は golden set に regression を append、Confluence だけにしない。目標は CI eval gate を authoritative release 契約とし四半期 deck を置換。
